declarations.docstring: Expands the dot product of an integer vector with its image under a square matrix as a double sum of matrix entries and vector coordinates.

A symmetric integer adjacency matrix has the asserted target property when it has zero diagonal, only zero-one entries, an edge path between every pair of indices, and a strictly positive `2I - adj` quadratic form on every nonzero coordinatewise nonnegative integer vector.
Expands the integer quadratic form associated with `2I - adj` as twice the sum of coordinate squares minus the adjacency-weighted double sum.
For an integer matrix with nonnegative entries, positivity of the `2I - adj` quadratic form on nonzero coordinatewise nonnegative integer vectors implies positivity on every nonzero integer vector.
Positivity of the `2I - adj` quadratic form on every nonzero integer vector implies positivity of its rational scalar extension on every nonzero rational vector.
For a symmetric integer matrix, positivity over nonzero rational vectors of the quadratic form associated with `2I - adj` implies that its real scalar extension is positive definite.
